sentences.en: I won't unload the car because that's somebody else's job.
sentences.zh: 这车我不会卸货了，因为那是别人的工作。

sentences.en: The ship anchored in the harbour and unloaded its goods.
sentences.zh: 船停泊在港口并卸下了货物。

sentences.en: It'll take some time to finish unloading the truck.
sentences.zh: 把卡车里的东西卸完还需要一些时间。

senses.zh: 卸(货)，卸下，摆脱...之负担，(大量)倾销
卸货，摆脱负担，退出(弹药，胶片等)
